-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionescape

go 1.27
-- m/p.go --
package p

import "logos/arena"

type node struct {
	next *node
	v    int
}

var global *node

var sinkRegion arena.Region

var sinkFn func()

//go:noinline
func keepHandle(h arena.Region) {
	sinkRegion = h
}

//go:noinline
func storeClo(f func()) {
	sinkFn = f
}

//go:noinline
func link(o, p *node) {
	o.next = p
}

func buildList() {
	r := arena.Open()
	var head *node
	for i := range 10 {
		n := arena.New[node](r)
		n.v = i
		n.next = head
		head = n
	}
	_ = head
}

func storeGlobal() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	p.v = 1
	global = p
	_ = p
}

func storeOutside() {
	var q *node
	{
		r := arena.Open()
		p := arena.New[node](r)
		p.v = 2
		q = p
		_ = p
	}
	_ = q
}

func nest193() {
	{
		rOut := arena.Open()
		po := arena.New[node](rOut)
		{
			rIn := arena.Open()
			pi := arena.New[node](rIn)
			po.next = pi
			_, _ = po, pi
		}
		_ = po
	}
}

func nest193Rev() {
	{
		rOut := arena.Open()
		po := arena.New[node](rOut)
		{
			rIn := arena.Open()
			pi := arena.New[node](rIn)
			pi.next = po
			_, _ = pi, po
		}
		_ = po
	}
}

func link193() {
	{
		rOut := arena.Open()
		po := arena.New[node](rOut)
		{
			rIn := arena.Open()
			pi := arena.New[node](rIn)
			link(po, pi)
			_, _ = po, pi
		}
		_ = po
	}
}

func link193Rev() {
	{
		rOut := arena.Open()
		po := arena.New[node](rOut)
		{
			rIn := arena.Open()
			pi := arena.New[node](rIn)
			link(pi, po)
			_, _ = pi, po
		}
		_ = po
	}
}

func loadSink193() {
	{
		rOut := arena.Open()
		po := arena.New[node](rOut)
		{
			rIn := arena.Open()
			slot := arena.New[*node](rIn)
			*slot = po
			q := *slot
			pi := arena.New[node](rIn)
			q.next = pi
			_, _ = po, pi
		}
		_ = po
	}
}

func appendUnknown() {
	r := arena.Open()
	heapSlice := make([]int, 0, 8)
	x := 1
	arena.Append[int](r, heapSlice, x)
	_ = x
	_ = heapSlice
}

func withGoto() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	i := 0
loop:
	i++
	if i < 3 {
		goto loop
	}
	_ = p
}

func killedRecord() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	p.v = 3
	keepHandle(r)
	_ = p
}

func closure191() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	p.v = 4
	f := func() { _ = r }
	storeClo(f)
	_ = p
}

func storeLocalAddr() {
	r := arena.Open()
	pi := arena.New[*int](r)
	lv := 5
	*pi = &lv
	_ = *pi
}
